runtime.localPersistence: versioned browser-local notes/settings; no cross-device sync claim

performanceTargets.purpose: initial authoring targets; revise from actual browser profiles, not measured results
performanceTargets.lodOrRetopology: inspect silhouettes and deformation before reducing
performanceTargets.lightStrategy: baked/static lighting where appropriate; restrict real-time shadows; modest bloom
performanceTargets.music: load selected/next track on demand, avoid predecoding full playlist

hosting.compression: choose host-supported gzip/Brotli with matching Content-Encoding; fallback only when headers unavailable and tested
hosting.assetNames: versioned build paths; do not reuse stale loader/data mix
hosting.embeds: test storage and fullscreen on actual host; use standalone page if iframe restrictions interfere

acceptance: real HTTP(S) served loader/WASM/data load without errors
Chrome and Edge room renders and clicks work
first user gesture starts audio, mute/next-volume operate
notes/settings persist across reload on same origin
background-tab return does not break action/timer/audio
representative character approach/sit/stand has no sliding or furniture penetration
profile memory/loading and reduce assets using measurements
mobile usability/compatibility reported only after actual device tests
